stock.description: Optima Automobile Group Holdings Limited, an investment holding entity, primarily specializes in providing aftermarket services for vehicles. Its diverse operations span four core segments: After-market Automotive Services, Car Rental Services, Automotive Supply Business, and Education Business Service. Within the After-market Automotive Services division, the company offers vehicle inspection, maintenance, and repair solutions. The Car Rental Services segment focuses on providing vehicle hire. Its Automotive Supply Business is engaged in trading motor vehicles and distributing passenger car spare parts, accessories, and automotive equipment across Singapore, Sri Lanka, and Myanmar. The Education Business Service segment concentrates on data collection and delivering management platform solutions. Beyond these, Optima Automobile Group Holdings Limited also offers franchise agency services and specialized spray painting for motor vehicles. The company was founded in Singapore in 2012, where it maintains its headquarters.
